chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Hanaan ibn Sadeer, from his father who said:
Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When you see the houses of Makkah, cut off the Talbiyya.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him).
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him).
key_terms.أَبْيَاتَ مَكَّةَ: The houses of Makkah, specifically referring to the Kaaba.
key_terms.التَّلْبِيَة: The ritual declaration 'Labbayk Allahumma labbayk' recited by pilgrims during Hajj.

ai.seo_question: When should a pilgrim stop reciting the Talbiyya during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the precise moment for terminating the Talbiyya upon sighting the Kaaba, a ruling derived from the Imams (peace be upon them) that marks the transition from the state of Ihram's declaration to the performance of Tawaf. Scholars note this signifies the completion of the preparatory phase of Hajj, aligning the pilgrim's verbal devotion with the physical proximity to the House of God. It reflects the Shia emphasis on following the Imams' specific guidance in ritual etiquette (adab) during the pilgrimage.
